name: NXUSD
oneLiner: NXUSD is a Nereus Finance overcollateralized CDP minted on Avalanche; the token has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern between $0.95 and $1.01.
collateral: Overcollateralized Nereus Finance lending positions, primarily Avalanche ecosystem crypto collateral
pegMechanism: Borrowed stablecoin minted against overcollateralized deposits in Nereus markets and repaid or liquidated through protocol rules

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: NXUSD token source exposes owner mint and user burn paths but no direct freeze, blacklist, pause, or seize function. Nereus materials describe DAI among NXUSD collateral, so DAI's freeze exposure resolves upstream.

reserves.name: Nereus overcollateralized crypto positions including DAI collateral

notices.title: Sustained soft depeg
notices.message: NXUSD has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern, with extended periods between $0.95 and $1.01 on CoinGecko/DefiLlama feeds. Treat collateral classification as advisory rather than live redemption assurance.

mintAuthority.summary: NXUSD is an overcollateralized CDP stablecoin minted on Avalanche against WBTC/WETH/AVAX/DAI collateral via Nereus Finance; the NRS/veNRS DAO and team multisig tune collateral and mint parameters.

mintIncidents.summary: A flash-loan manipulation of the AVAX/USDC JLP collateral price let an attacker borrow far more NXUSD than justified by collateral, creating about $500K of NXUSD bad debt.

sources.label: Financial Express - Nereus NXUSD bad debt

controls.label: Nereus NXUSD minter / CDP contracts
controls.capDescription: Mint capped per-collateral by overcollateralized LTV (up to ~90%) inside Nereus CDP vaults.
controls.evidence: Nereus docs describe NXUSD as an overcollateralized ERC-20 minted by depositing WBTC/WETH/AVAX/DAI; mint is gated by per-collateral LTV inside the protocol's CDP contracts.

controls.label: Nereus governance (NRS / veNRS DAO + team multisig)
controls.evidence: Nereus governance docs describe an NRS/veNRS staking DAO plus a documented team multisig that administers protocol parameters such as accepted collateral and limits.

review.evidence: Nereus Finance documentation and explorer coverage describe NXUSD as an overcollateralized Avalanche CDP minted against whitelisted crypto collateral, with an NRS/veNRS DAO and a team multisig administering parameters; no on-chain owner/minter admin was independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain owner/minter admin of the NXUSD token and CDP contracts and the team multisig threshold on Snowtrace.
Project pivoted away from the Avalanche lending product; confirm whether mint/CDP administration is still actively maintained.
